coverLetter:
Daniel Okafor
Leeds, UK
daniel.okafor@example.org
+44 20 5550 0188

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Figma

Dear Hiring Manager,

Getting a high volume of customers to a successful outcome without losing the personal touch is the challenge behind your Scale Onboarding role. I face a small version of it every term as a Head of Year, running weekly parent calls for a year group of 210 students, and I've learned how to keep each conversation clear and useful at that volume.

As a Teacher of Physics and Head of Year 9 at Ashgrove Academy, I wrote the department's Year 9 practical curriculum and trained 12 colleagues to use it, which is the kind of content and enablement work your role calls for. I also raised the share of Year 11 students reaching grade 5 or above from 71% to 86% over three years, tracking progress in Excel and Google Sheets and presenting results to senior leadership each term. That's the habit of reporting on metrics to shape what comes next. I haven't managed B2B SaaS onboarding, but I've spent eight years explaining complex ideas to audiences with very different levels of knowledge, from students to parents to senior leaders. I'm also a quick learner: I completed Python for Everybody on Coursera in 2024 and I'm working through the Google Data Analytics Certificate.

Your "Grow as you go" value describes how I work. I'd welcome a conversation about how I could help Figma build a scale onboarding program that customers feel supported by, and I'm available to talk at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Program Manager, Daniel Okafor
applicationEmail.body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I run weekly parent calls and two parents' evenings a term for a year group of 210 students, so I'm used to guiding many people toward the same goal while speaking to very different audiences. I've also built and delivered training for adults, including trained 12 colleagues on a curriculum I wrote, which is the kind of workshop facilitation I'd bring to your customer programs. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I'm available for a call any weekday after 4pm UK time, and I can start a conversation about the role whenever suits you.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor
